objective: Proof: on every knot tree of parity, not-all-equal and betweenness knots, bond distance = steps apart + 1; the mixed cycle's pair at bond distance two.
status: Proved 2026-11-18 (referee pending): on every knot tree of parity, not-all-equal and betweenness knots, in any mixture, bond distance (least bond holding both, minus one) is steps apart plus one on every pair; the lower bound holds for any three-place knots passing K2 (a bond missing a path knot's third branch splits into independent parts), equality fails for the clause 'not all ones' (no bond holds a chain's ends); on the mixed cycle bond distance reads the parity knot as one knot. So bond distance has no hub shortcut.
title: Bond distance on knot trees
